authorization: Lead S4 directive at e9ecd45: implement ControlValueAccessor (writeValue/registerOnChange/registerOnTouched/setDisabledState); integrate reactive+template forms with no separate selection authority; call onChange for GENUINE user edits only; mark touched at a user boundary; reconcile disabled; prove via a real compiled Angular consumer. Preserve S3 bridge + cleanup + browser-deferred loading. One atomic commit. No SSR hydration/S5, no core refactor, no API-065/API-075, no core event-contract change.

controlValueAccessor.registerOnChange: stores fn; called only from the user-edit branch
controlValueAccessor.registerOnTouched: stores fn; called only from markTouched() at a user edit boundary

setDisabledState.derivedState: disabled = formDisabled || disabledInput (form wins while form-controlled)

controlValueAccessor.onChangeFireRule: ONLY for genuine user edits (provenance-classified); exactly once per user gesture; never for writeValue/init/reconcile/async
controlValueAccessor.onTouchedRule: only at a user edit boundary; never on init render or writeValue

provenance.whyCoreReasonUnreachable: EnhancedSelect tracks SelectionReason privately (SELECTION_CHANGED effect -> _effectRunner only); it is not in the change payload, DOM, or any callback. Exposing it would be a core change (out of S4 scope).
provenance.model: DOM-gesture probes + programmatic windows + gesture-sequence classification
provenance.probes: capture-phase click/keydown listeners on the element's shadow root(s); count a gesture on option click / chip-remove click / clear-button click / selection key (Enter, Space, a) while the listbox is open
provenance.classification: user iff origin==='user' AND currentUserSeq > lastUserSeq (and not inside a synchronous programmatic window); gesture consumed so one gesture -> at most one user edit

selectionAuthority.formControlled: form model is the single source of truth; [value] ignored for reconciliation
selectionAuthority.feedbackLoop: none ([value] never written back from a forwarded change)

s3BoundaryPreserved.classificationLocation: inside the existing change listener, before stopPropagation()/emit

disclosedLimitations: Provenance is DOM-gesture based (clicks + Enter/Space/a while open). A keyboard path that selects without one of those gestures would be classified programmatic; a complete mapping needs core's private SelectionReason (a core change, out of S4 scope).
Peer range >=21 <22 unchanged; @angular/forms added within that range.
SSR setup loads @angular/compiler so partial-compiled @angular/* FESMs (from the forms import) can JIT-fallback; no DOM/core introduced, spec no-DOM/no-core evidence intact.

relationshipToPriorIncrements.effect: Adds Angular forms integration; S5 (SSR hydration) remains NO-GO pending authorization.
